dedupe_keys.name: building information and structural models of archetype commercial buildings located in the central and eastern united states

description: Building Information and Structural Models of Archetype Commercial Buildings Located in the Central and Eastern United States is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Madeleine Flint, Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University (vt.edu). This repository contains design documents, building plans, and Building Information and Structural Models associated with 6 professionally-designed alternatives for a hypothetical 4-story office building located in Charleston, South Carolina. The VT-RSB archetypes have identical external and similar internal layouts to support well-controlled comparative assessment of soil-foundation-structure-envelope (SFSE) systems. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-4k0j-nq17. Keywords: Archetype, Commercial Building, Structures, Taxonomy, BlM, Design. Published 2021-04-05. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
